settings.question: Do you offer fleet pricing on tires?
settings.answer: Yes, through a business account. Approved accounts see our wholesale price on the tire and wheel brands we import ourselves. For other brands, call us with your tire sizes and number of vehicles and we will quote them.

settings.question: What types of commercial vehicles do you service?
settings.answer: We service light commercial vehicles: cargo vans, half-ton and three-quarter-ton trucks, full-size SUVs and the passenger cars in a fleet. We carry LT and commercial-rated tires for higher load ratings, and we can get major brands including Michelin, Bridgestone, Goodyear and Hankook. We do not service heavy transport trucks.

settings.question: Can you invoice my business?
settings.answer: Yes. Invoices are made out to your business, and all your vehicles can sit under one business account. Payment is due when the work is done or when you pick up your order.

settings.question: Can you take several fleet vehicles at once?
settings.answer: Yes. Call or text either shop with your vehicles and tire sizes, and we will book them in back to back where the day allows. Booking before the October winter-tire rush gives you the most choice of times.

settings.question: How do I apply for a business account?
settings.answer: Fill in the short form on our wholesale application page and choose Fleet operator as your business type. We review each application by hand and contact you about it. When you are approved, we email you an invite to our dealer portal. Existing retail customers can apply too.

settings.heading: What a business account includes today
settings.body:
• Our wholesale price on the tire and wheel brands we import ourselves
  • Online ordering in our dealer portal, with pickup at Edmonton Trail NE
  • Installs on your vehicles at 42 Ave SW or Edmonton Trail NE. Call or text to book.
  • Quotes on other brands for your sizes
  • Invoices made out to your business. Payment is due when the work is done or when you pick up.

Call 42 Ave SW at (403) 452-4283 or Edmonton Trail NE at (825) 395-4024.

settings.lead: Book the fleet as a block, not one van at a time
settings.text: Several vehicles through in sequence beats each driver calling separately when a tire finally gives up.

settings.lead: Get ahead of the October rush
settings.text: Commercial vehicles compete with every retail customer in the city for the same three weeks. Fleets that schedule in September are not in that queue.

settings.lead: Standardise sizes where the fleet allows
settings.text: A fleet running two or three sizes instead of nine is faster to stock for and quicker to turn around.

settings.lead: Load ratings are not optional on a working vehicle
settings.text: A loaded van or a trailer needs the load index it was built for. Passenger-rated rubber on a working vehicle wears fast and is a liability question, not just a cost one.

settings.lead: Winter rating matters more when the vehicle has to go out
settings.text: A fleet that runs regardless of weather needs 3PMSF tires. Being unable to reach a job is a worse outcome than a slower commute.

settings.heading: Fleet tire work is a scheduling problem
settings.intro: For a business the tire itself is rarely the expensive part. A van off the road on a Tuesday morning costs more than the rubber does.
settings.outro: Fleet pricing runs through our wholesale program. See the wholesale program or call (403) 452-4283 with your fleet size and tire sizes.
